base: v1.21 with explicit range-direction reset and local-now anchoring
ui_scope: HTML/CSS UI-only refinement; tracker behavior and Cesium globe logic unchanged
ui_changes: portrait mode uses a horizontal glowing circular-thumb slider

Sun/Moon tracker icon starts inactive and panel stays closed on launch
controls remain above the bottom safe-area inset
changes: Turn the existing Sun/Moon choice buttons into thick translucent glass capsule controls with circular luminous knobs, matching the user's exact visual reference more closely.
Keep the same Sun/Moon button IDs, aria-pressed behavior, and tracker event handlers.
Compact the initial option panel and add viewport/safe-area constraints to reduce overlap risk.
Use a compact vertical stack of glass capsule controls in landscape and preserve side-by-side selection in portrait.
Preserve existing Cosmic Glow time slider markup and behavior.
Do not change app.js, data-store.js, sun-moon-tracker.js, moon-dataset.js, or Cesium globe/camera/gesture logic.
Not runtime-tested on iPhone; visual/interaction testing required.
